description: Provision a Google Cloud Vertexai VertexAIDataset via Config Connector. Fields mirror the vertexai.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 VertexAIDataset spec.

displayName.description: The user-defined name of the Dataset. The name can be up to 128 characters long and can consist of any UTF-8 characters.

encryptionSpec.description: Immutable. Customer-managed encryption key spec for a Dataset. If set, this Dataset and all sub-resources of this Dataset will be secured by this key.

kmsKeyNameRef.description: Required. The Cloud KMS resource identifier of the customer managed encryption key used to protect a resource. Has the form: projects/my-project/locations/my-region/keyRings/my-kr/cryptoKeys/my-key. The key needs to be in the same region as where the compute resource is created. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed KMSCryptoKey. Should be in the format `projects/[kms_project_id]/locations/[region]/keyRings/[key_ring_id]/cryptoKeys/[key]`.

metadataSchemaUri.description: Immutable. Points to a YAML file stored on Google Cloud Storage describing additional information about the Dataset. The schema is defined as an OpenAPI 3.0.2 Schema Object. The schema files that can be used here are found in gs://google-cloud-aiplatform/schema/dataset/metadata/.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

region.description: Immutable. The region of the dataset. eg us-central1.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The service-generated name of the resource. Used for acquisition only. Leave unset to create a new resource.
